[[Speak with Headmaster Amara (Monk)]] | followed by = [[Stale Mate]] | profession = Monk | primary = y | secondary = n }} [[Headmaster Amara]] sends you to your first [[monk]] instructor [[Sister Tai]]. ==Quest information== ===Requirements=== {{ Standard prerequisites | campaign = factions | profession = Monk | primary = y | secondary = n }} ===Objectives=== * Search [[Sunqua Vale]] for Sister Tai. ===Early benefits=== *You receive a [[Starter Holy Rod]] and the following skills after accepting this quest: **{{skill icon|Bane Signet}} **{{skill icon|Healing Breeze}} **{{skill icon|Orison of Healing}} ***You may already have Bane Signet and Orison of Healing if your primary profession is monk. ===Reward=== * 100 [[Experience]] * 10 [[Gold]] ==Walkthrough== Exit [[Shing Jea Monastery]] and head Northwest in Sunqua Vale until you reach [[Yundin Circle]]. You will encounter [[Mantid Drone]]s on the way, but they will not attack unless you attack them first. Speak to Sister Tai to receive your reward. ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Headmaster Amara :''"You are ready to begin your training? Excellent. It is good to see such enthusiasm in one so young. The life of a Monk is sometimes all too tranquil, in my opinion."'' :''"Sister Tai, my apprentice, will administer your first lesson. She is an accomplished Monk, and you can learn a great deal from her, if you pay attention. You'll find her in Sunqua Vale."'' {{ Offer dialog | accept = I will look for Sister Tai."'' | decline = I'm not quite ready yet."'' | ask = Sister Tai awaits you in Sunqua Vale. When you are ready to begin your training, seek her out. }} ===Reward dialogue=== ;Sister Tai :''"Headmaster Amara has seen something in you, else she would not have sent you to me so soon. It is good that you have joined our ranks. If you are ready, I will teach you the basics of healing. Perhaps I can learn something from you, as well."''
